title: Scalar-mate compatibility with normalized direct-image reconstruction
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,L/\mathbf Q_\ell$, an embedding $\iota:E\to L$, and any scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$. Choose normalized LimitComparison data $C_E,C_L$ [lem-weil-direct-image-limit-comparison]. Let $P_F$ be ordinary completed-coefficient derived direct image, $D_F=R_{F,X} H_{F,f} L_{F,Y}$ the actual system realization, and $r_F:P_F\to D_F$ the composite of the identity-on-ordinary-direct-images derived comparison, image of the reduction/limit unit, and inverse of $C_F.derived$ [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization]. Let $S_W$ be ordinary completed scalar extension, $T_W$ the actual integral scalar extension, and $\chi_W:S_W\to T_W$ the canonical quotient-completion map [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. Let $\gamma:S_Y P_E\to P_L S_X$ be the prescribed ordinary scalar-adjunction mate [def-sp-coefficient-mate-comparisons], and $\beta:T_Y D_E\to D_L T_X$ the specified coefficientExchange for systemDirect and its systemDirectScalar mate. For every integral constructible $K$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], the actual morphisms satisfy
$$S_Y(r_{E,K});\chi_{Y,D_EK};\beta_K=\gamma_K;P_L(\chi_{X,K});r_{L,T_XK}.$$
This asserts equality with the recorded units and counits, not invertibility of any mate. The chosen limit comparisons include their whole-complex derived-unit normalizations. No properness or absolute separatedness assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat representative P of K using [lem-pc-kflat-resolution], and form its one coherent quotient system before localizing. The scalar comparison of [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization] is normalized on these actual generators and their quotient transitions. Reconstruction r is the actual reduction/limit unit followed by the inverse limit/direct-image comparison from [lem-weil-direct-image-limit-comparison]. Expand these maps and chi, retaining the ordinary completed-direct-image presentation comparison, so the two composites have the displayed common source and target.

Expand beta as scalarSourceComparison, total limit of systemDirectScalar, then the inverse scalarReductionIso [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization]. Naturality moves the system reduction counit through the direct-image map. Transpose the remaining scalar/direct-image square using the actual geometric adjunction of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. The ordinary and system maps have the same transpose: the geometric counit tensored with identity. The tensor reassociation sends x tensor s tensor b to x tensor sb in either order, including every quotient transition [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]. The triangle equations cancel each inserted scalar-reduction map with its inverse.

In the signed strict Roos presentation the product coordinate of each resulting map is the same quotient map from Step 2; both augmentations have zero shifted coordinate. Hence the comparison holds on the whole Roos complex, not just after individual derived evaluations [lem-weil-strict-roos-comparison]. The whole-complex normalization of C_E,C_L transports this equation to the universal direct-image/limit models. Apply injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence and localize the K-flat representatives to obtain the displayed equality for K. Identity scalar maps, K=0 and empty schemes satisfy the same formulas.

theorem directImageScalarRealizationSquare
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E L : Type u) [Field E] [Field L]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [Algebra (Padic l) L]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[Padic l] L) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (CE : StrictDirectImageMixedUnit.LimitComparison l E f)
    (CL : StrictDirectImageMixedUnit.LimitComparison l L f)
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) :
    (completedDerivedScalarExtension l E L ι Y).map
        ((directImageReconstruction l E f CE).app K.obj) ≫
      (completedScalarComparison l E L ι Y).app
        ((FrobeniusExchange.integralDirectImage l E f).obj K.obj) ≫
      (FrobeniusExchange.coefficientExchange l E L ι
        (FrobeniusExchange.systemDirect l E f) (FrobeniusExchange.systemDirect l L f)
        (FrobeniusExchange.systemDirectScalar l E L ι f)).app K =
    (PurCompactSupport.properComparison (PurCompactSupport.completedChange l E L ι) f).app
        K.obj ≫
      (PurCompactSupport.push (PurCompactSupport.completed l L) f).map
        ((completedScalarComparison l E L ι X).app K.obj) ≫
      (directImageReconstruction l L f CL).app
        ((integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E L ι X).obj K.obj)
